services.name: Na Hoku 2 Sunset Sail (Kewalo Harbor)
services.desc: Our Sunset Sail tour is a fun and wild 90-minute sail where all drinks are complimentary! (Must be 21+ with valid ID to consume alcoholic beverages) $50 (base price) Flat Per Guest. All guests must have a ticket (including young children/infants) as each guest contributes to our total legal capacity. We advise parents/guardians to reconsider when bringing young children on board as these sails can present a party environment and bar atmosphere.We are not responsible for the actions or expressions of fellow guests on board. 90 minutes Location We are located at Kewalo Basin 90 Minute Sail • Daily at 5:30pm • Complimentary Drinks

services.name: Manu Kai Harbor Sunset Sail
services.desc: >The Manu Kai crew invites you to join us on our nightly Sunset Sailing trip. Experience sailing, sightseeing, complimentary cocktails, the beautiful Hawaiian Sunset, and perhaps if you're lucky the rare green flash! Located at 1025 Ala Moana Blvd Slip F22 Pricing: > - Adults (Ages 21+) - $50 > - Children (Under 0-20) - $50 Sunset sail is a flat rate, ALL guests must purchase a ticket to attend (including infants!) Includes: Soda, Juice, Water, and up to 3 complimentary $50 Per Guest • 90 Minutes • Complimentary Drinks

services.name: Na Hoku 2 - South Shore Sail (Kewalo Harbor)
services.desc: 90-minute fun-filled day sail from Kewalo Basin Harbor! Set sail on the high seas and enjoy complimentary beverages of all kinds, great views of the south shore of Oahu, and maybe a splash or two! Enjoy the breeze and views of Ala Moana, Waikiki's coast, and the iconic Diamond Head (Lēʻahi). 90 Minutes Location We are located at Kewalo Basin Harbor at Pier F23. Address: 1025 Ala Moana Blvd, Honolulu, HI, 96814 Please proceed to the boat itself as we do not have a check-in booth! We are the big YELLOW and RED catamaran named NA HOKU 2 These sails depart from Kewalo Harbor and 90 Minute Sail • Daily Sails at 9:30am/11:30am/1:30pm/3:30pm • Complimentary Drinks

quotes.text: This was a great experience. This sail is very calm and relaxing and a completely different experience from the trade wind sails, where you expect to get tossed around and get wet. The crew was very friendly and attentive. The sunset was gorgeous, even though it was overcast all day. My wife and I now prefer this sail over the trade winds sails we have done in the past. Great sail!

quotes.author: DVA4laughs
quotes.text: This is the best deal in Waikiki. Was there for a week and went on this cruise three times. ~$30 for one hour sail with open bar. So, you can sit in a hotel bar and nurse one drink or be on the ocean enjoying amazing views, listen to lively music and chug down multiple drinks. No brainer. Shout out to Dustin for the amazing sailing experience.

quotes.author: reefbreaks
quotes.text: They have this operation dialed in. It is short but very sweet. The open bar and fun, yet competent, staff makes for good times on the water. The views are great, they have good music going, and it is fun meeting other folks on board. Definitely check it out!

This was a total blast! The guys running the boat were friendly and entertaining. The sites were phenomenal. The sea life is gorgeous. And the drinks were very good. I booked a second trip, can’t wait to sale again!
My friend was visiting me on the island and we both loved this experience! The crew is so refreshing and fun! It was a mix of young and old! It was a great time! Would definitely recommend!
What a wonderful experience! The crew was friendly and fun. The drinks were tasty and plentiful. The sunset was gorgeous and the moonrise was a terrific bonus. I highly recommend!
